raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`DeepSeekV31Detector` (`deepseekv31`) scans model output with patterns that go quadratic when `<｜tool▁call▁end｜>` never arrives:

1. `parse_streaming_increment` runs `re.search(r"<｜tool▁call▁begin｜>(.*)<｜tool▁sep｜>(.*?)(<｜tool▁call▁end｜>|$)")` over the **whole buffer on every chunk**. With repeated `<｜tool▁call▁begin｜>` tokens and no separator, each call retries the greedy scan from every begin token.
2. `detect_and_parse` uses `re.findall(begin.*?end)`, rescanning to the end from every begin token, then a greedy detail pattern per block.

| Input | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| 130 KB, one streaming call | 9.9 s | ~0 |
| 30 KB stream in 64-char (multi-token / MTP) chunks | 0.66 s worst chunk, **84 s total** | 0.1 ms worst chunk |
| 130 KB, non-stream | 9.4 s | ~0 |

Tool-call parsing runs synchronously on the tokenizer manager's event loop, so one such response stalls every in-flight request. Found with an Atheris fuzzing harness that records per-input parse time.

## Modifications

The three patterns are replaced with linear `find` / `rfind` helpers that return the same groups:
- `_iter_call_blocks`: `begin.*?end` spans.
- `_search_complete_call`: `begin(.*)sep(.*)end`. The match starts at the first begin, and the greedy groups end at the last end token and at the last separator before it.
- `_search_partial_call`: `begin(.*)sep(.*?)(end|$)`. The name group ends at the last separator. The lazy argument group stops at the first end token, else at `$`, which, as in `re`, is end of text or just before a trailing newline.

The unused regex attributes and `import re` are removed. A new `TestDeepSeekV31Detector` regression test fails on `main` and passes here (there was no V3.1 test class).

## Accuracy Tests

- Helpers vs the original patterns on 300k random token strings: identical.
- Differential test of `main` vs patched detector (20k random + 20k mutated well-formed inputs, streaming under random re-chunking and non-streaming): **0 mismatches** (11.4k produced parsed calls).
- `test/registered/unit/function_call/`: 630 passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

See the table above.

Related: #42592 (same fix for DeepSeek-V3), #42573 – #42591 (same issue class in other tool-call parsers).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

@@ -1,7 +1,6 @@
 import json
 import logging
-import re
-from typing import List
+from typing import List, Optional, Tuple
 
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import Tool
 from sglang.srt.function_call.base_format_detector import BaseFormatDetector
@@ -16,6 +15,56 @@
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
 
+_CALL_BEGIN = "<｜tool▁call▁begin｜>"
+_CALL_END = "<｜tool▁call▁end｜>"
+_SEP = "<｜tool▁sep｜>"
+
+
+# The helpers below are linear equivalents of re.search over the regexes they
+# name; those backtrack over every begin/sep token when the end never arrives.
+def _iter_call_blocks(text: str):
+    # `begin.*?end` spans, as (start, end).
+    start = text.find(_CALL_BEGIN)
+    while start != -1:
+        end = text.find(_CALL_END, start + len(_CALL_BEGIN))
+        if end == -1:
+            return
+        end += len(_CALL_END)
+        yield start, end
+        start = text.find(_CALL_BEGIN, end)
+
+
+def _search_complete_call(text: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str]]:
+    # `begin(.*)sep(.*)end` -> (name, args).
+    start = text.find(_CALL_BEGIN)
+    end = text.rfind(_CALL_END)
+    if start == -1 or end == -1:
+        return None
+    sep = text.rfind(_SEP, start + len(_CALL_BEGIN), end)
+    if sep == -1:
+        return None
+    return text[start + len(_CALL_BEGIN) : sep], text[sep + len(_SEP) : end]
+
+
+def _search_partial_call(text: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str, str, int]]:
+    # `begin(.*)sep(.*?)(end|$)` -> (name, args, end token or "", match end).
+    start = text.find(_CALL_BEGIN)
+    if start == -1:
+        return None
+    sep = text.rfind(_SEP, start + len(_CALL_BEGIN))
+    if sep == -1:
+        return None
+    name, args_start = text[start + len(_CALL_BEGIN) : sep], sep + len(_SEP)
+    end = text.find(_CALL_END, args_start)
+    if end != -1:
+        return name, text[args_start:end], _CALL_END, end + len(_CALL_END)
+    # `$` also matches just before a trailing newline.
+    stop = (
+        len(text) - 1 if text.endswith("\n") and len(text) > args_start else len(text)
+    )
+    return name, text[args_start:stop], "", stop
+
+
 class DeepSeekV31Detector(BaseFormatDetector):
     """
     Detector for DeepSeek V3 model function call format.

 import unittest
 import warnings

 from sglang.srt.function_call.function_call_parser import FunctionCallParser

@@ -1565,6 +1567,38 @@ def test_parse_streaming_multiple_tool_calls_with_multi_token_chunk(self):
         self.assertEqual(params2["city"], "Beijing")
 
 
+class TestDeepSeekV31Detector(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_unclosed_tool_call_tags_parse_in_linear_time(self):
+        """Repeated call-begin tokens without a closing one must not stall the
+        parser (it runs on the event loop); a complete call still parses."""
+        tools = [
+            Tool(
+                type="function",
+                function=Function(
+                    name="get_weather",
+                    parameters={
+                        "type": "object",
+                        "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}},
+                    },
+                ),
+            ),
+        ]
+        begin = "<｜tool▁call▁begin｜>"
+        complete = (
+            "<｜tool▁calls▁begin｜>" + begin + "get_weather<｜tool▁sep｜>"
+            '{"city": "Paris"}<｜tool▁call▁end｜>'
+        )
+
+        start = time.perf_counter()
+        result = DeepSeekV31Detector().detect_and_parse(complete + begin * 8000, tools)
+        DeepSeekV31Detector().parse_streaming_increment(begin * 8000, tools)
+        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
+
+        self.assertLess(elapsed, 1.0)
+        self.assertEqual(len(result.calls), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.calls[0].parameters), {"city": "Paris"})
+
+
 class TestDeepSeekV32Detector(unittest.TestCase):
     def setUp(self):
         """Set up test tools and detector for DeepSeekV32 format testing."""
